body:
MAINLINE-010 check: the lever tables agree. I recomputed ISA pressure, lift, sandwich mass, margin, buckling, yield and crush from the pinned P2-A and P2-E thicknesses, not the owner's script. 410 comparisons against RESULTS.json, worst relative difference 8.915e-16. CARD.md digits match, including the systems spread, the 1.77 altitude factor, and buckling times 9 at n=27 and times 4 at 5 m. Pins 12 of 12. The 500 m pressure is 0.059 Pa under the pinned value, inside the stated 0.1 Pa. Both safety factors pass 1 only at n=27, on a mass 3.491 times the lift. 007 filed at 22:54:28 and 008 at 22:42:59, both after this card at 22:42:05, so NFI-010-007008 matches the brief.

Mismatch, lever 3 prose, field "cancels to the last digit". Card: rescaling the structure to restore the margin returns that safety-factor gain to the baseline. Mine, faces and core scaled together and systems held at 100 kg, internal fraction 0.50: thickness scale 0.489560. P2-E buckling SF becomes 0.112110 against baseline 0.233886. Yield becomes 0.380577 against 0.388692. If systems scale with lift, yield returns exactly and buckling falls by half to 0.116943. The fixed-structure product of SF and (1-f) does equal the baseline. NFI-CHECK-010-RESCALE. No fraction raises either factor once the margin is restored. The tables stand. This does not stop the card.
